_comment: Product catalogue. This is the PRODUCT dimension of the system: one entry per
distinct physical product. Sellers/listings are a separate concern -- adapters
generate listings from these entries (see src/adapters/synthetic_adapter.py),
and a live adapter such as eBay bypasses this file entirely.
WHY THIS FILE REPLACED sample_listings.json AS THE SOURCE OF TRUTH.
The old file was a flat list of 15 listings for 7 products, all electronics.
That made 'browse any product' impossible and made attribute extraction look
more general than it was -- storage/colour happen to describe a phone but say
nothing about a mixer grinder or a laptop.
FIELDS
product_id     stable identity. Also the gold cluster label for evaluation.
category       drives which attribute extractors apply. See src/matching/categories.py
attributes     the hard specs. Two products differing on any of these are
DIFFERENT products and must never merge.
mrp            anchor price in INR. Seller prices are derived from this.
search_terms   what to put in a retailer search URL. See src/links.py
complements    products genuinely bought alongside this one. Feeds the
recommender's complement rules -- this is what makes
'customers also bought' relevant rather than random.
title_variants how different sellers word the same product. This is the
entity-resolution test set: reordering, abbreviation,
marketing noise and casing all have to collapse to one cluster.
Prices are indicative Indian-market figures, not live quotes.
